Definition: of Hebrew origin (H5601); a "sapphire" or lapis-lazuli gem:--sapphire.
BiblicalUsage: Scripture uses sáppheiros for a "sapphire" or lapis-lazuli gem. It stands in Revelation 21:19: "…manner of precious stones. The first foundation jasper…" — in the SBL text the stone is spelled σάπφιρος.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sáppheiros is worth knowing, because nothing in Scripture is there by accident.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
